_comment: Receives normalized ElevenLabs intake data and creates an invoice in the backend. Buyer phone number doubles as the Breeth buyerId since the API has no separate buyer_id field.
name: Vasooli 01 - Intake Handler

parameters.content: Validate Hindi voice intake, store invoice, then persist memory keyed by buyer phone.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { buyer_name: $json.buyer_name, buyer_phone: $json.buyer_phone, buyer_email: $json.buyer_email, invoice_number: $json.invoice_number, amount: $json.amount, invoice_date: $json.invoice_date, language: $json.language || "hi" } }}

={{ { jsonrpc: "2.0", id: Date.now(), method: "tools/call", params: { name: "store_memory", arguments: { buyerId: $json.buyer_phone, intent: "invoice_context", content: { invoice_id: $json.invoice_id, invoice_number: $json.invoice_number, amount: $json.amount, due_date: $json.due_date } } } } }}
